title: Control request (one JSON line sent to the control plane)
description: What a client writes on the pipe or the unix socket. The host decodes JSON and trusts nothing: a request that does not match is refused, never repaired. Unknown keys are ignored by readers (additive evolution).

cmd.description: The command; blank after trimming is refused with code `invalid`.

token.description: The per-launch credential (backend or cli). Never journalled.

command.description: The registry command id a typed call (`ui`, `run`) names.

args.description: Array of strings for shell commands, object for registry commands.

capability.description: One-shot capability id the host issued for exactly this call. Never journalled.

requestId.description: The caller's name for the attempt. Not a credential.
